headline: JSW Energy: NCLT Convenes Unsecured Creditors' Meeting on 20 July 2026
sum: JSW Energy Limited notified the stock exchange of an NCLT-ordered meeting of unsecured creditors scheduled for 20 July 2026, signalling a formal insolvency or debt-restructuring proceeding under the Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code.
detail: JSW Energy Limited, a major renewable and thermal energy producer, has been directed by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, to convene a meeting of its unsecured creditors on 20 July 2026. This notice was filed with the National Stock Exchange on 18 June 2026 as per mandatory disclosure requirements. The NCLT order triggering this meeting indicates commencement of formal insolvency proceedings or an IBC-structured debt restructuring. Unsecured creditors' separate convocation suggests either a Class II creditor resolution plan or a bifurcated voting structure under the IBC, 2016 framework.
